panels.description: NEXUS: a route marker stands far behind the coastal cave entrance. Roman arrives at one access point; Sitara and Nayah at another. Do not show Falcon nearby. Leave upper area clear.
Inside the cave, Sitara, Roman, and Nayah meet beneath warped metal and blue ice; their separate TJs face each other across a frozen threshold. Leave upper third for dialogue.
Roman holds chemical calibration sheet; Sitara holds Falcon fragment. They study documents rather than each other. Leave upper third for dialogue.
Nayah plants a route marker and chalks an exit arrow. Leave upper-left for her command.

items.speaker: ROMAN
items.text: This code is in your record.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: Your record is the second half.

items.speaker: NAYAH
items.text: We work inside the route. We leave when I say.
